role.text: I was the tech lead for the checkout team.
quotes: I was the tech lead on checkout

problem.text: The team was moving checkout to a new payments provider, and the rollout was already two weeks late.
quotes: we were moving checkout to the new payments provider
the rollout was already two weeks late

goal.text: Ship the new provider before Black Friday without breaking checkout.
quotes: Black Friday was a month out and checkout could not break

did.text: I split the rollout so five percent of traffic went to the new provider first.
quotes: I split it so five percent of traffic went to the new provider first

why.text: A small slice showed failures early, while they were still cheap to fix.
quotes: if it broke I wanted it to break small

metric.text: We finished a week before Black Friday, and not one payment failed.
quotes: we were done a week before Black Friday and not one payment failed

lesson.text: Rolling out in small slices turns a big launch into a series of small, safe ones.
quotes: small slices made it a bunch of small launches instead of one scary one
